message: Done. 5 m local-inertial rain-on-grid (73.8 M cells, WebGPU RX 580, ~24 min GPU per 3 h storm, mass error ~5e-5) for design storms Tr 2/10/100 (37/56/83 mm in 60 min). Published per scenario: max-depth tiles z10-15, hazard tiles z10-15, arrival tiles z10-14, 5-min animation frames, routing polygons (depth classes 15-30/30-60/>60 cm, 1.6/4.8/9.0 MB), validation vs IMEPLAN, stats.json, README. Registered in hazard/index.json (sim-hidro-t{2,10,100}-profundidad, -clases). Viewer /labs/sim-hidro/ with demo mode and screenshot. GPU lock released.
